values.title: Observability
values.summary: Logs, metrics and slow-query insights for every environment.
values.body:
## Logs

Terminal

```
npx tessera logs --env production --follow
npx tessera logs --function welcome-email --since 1h
```

## Metrics

Metric

What it tells you

Request rate

API calls per second, by endpoint.

p95 latency

How long the slowest 5% of requests take.

Error rate

Share of requests returning 4xx or 5xx.

Rows scanned

Early warning for missing indexes.

## Exporting

Send logs and metrics to Datadog, Grafana or any OpenTelemetry collector from **Project settings → Observability**.
